# 1. Problem 4.14

## data import
```{r}
students <- read_table("Students.dat.txt")
head(students)
```

## (a)
```{r}
xbar <- mean(students$tv)
s <- sd(students$tv)
n <- length(students$tv)

# n = 60, which is bigger than 30.
# It should be considered as a big sample size.
lower <- xbar - qnorm(0.975) * s / sqrt(n)
upper <- xbar + qnorm(0.975) * s / sqrt(n)

c(lower, upper)
```
